The opinions in this video are our own, and we're excited to partner with ControlAI on this video to help grow the campaign to prevent catastrophic risks from AI.

author: The Infographics Show
description:
Head to https://www.teamhuman.org/ to join the movement to keep humans in control of AI.

The internet is being flooded with AI-generated content, and Team Human wants to make sure real human creativity doesn’t disappear beneath it.

AI can now generate images, voices, articles, websites, and entire videos at a scale no human creator can match. What once looked obviously artificial is becoming increasingly difficult to distinguish from genuine work.
The problem isn’t simply that AI exists. The Infographics Show uses AI as a tool for specific production tasks, while human researchers, writers, animators, editors, and voice artists remain responsible for creating the videos you watch.
The concern is what happens when platforms treat carefully crafted human work, automated AI spam, and deepfake content exactly the same.

title: The AI slop situation is a mess
